question.html:
In an experiment alpha particles are fired at a thin metal foil at high speeds. A small fraction of these particles are deflected through large angles. 

Which feature of the atom cannot be deduced from the results of this experiment?

  1. The nucleus occupies a very small percentage of the entire volume of the atom
  2. The nucleus contains positively charged and neutral particles
  3. Positive and negative charge is not uniformly distributed within an atom
  4. Most of the mass of the atom is found in the nucleus
